interface.title: Make My Figure v1.3.2 (Streamlit)
interface.field: General laboratory and biomedical science: omics, clinical, pharmacology and comparison data
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and reporting: turning tabular results into manuscript-ready figures with matching statistics and machine-readable reproducibility files
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a results table, pick or accept a recommended plot type, map columns to plot roles, tune a single Publication style, run assumption-checked statistics, and export SVG/PNG/PDF with PlotSpec/StatsSpec JSON and a reopenable figure package.

data.note: Mostly the app's built-in examples ('Bundled sample' → 'Example dataset (by plot type)'): 'Dose-response curve' (60 rows: drug, concentration_uM, viability_pct) and 'Box / violin plot with points' (72 rows: Healthy/Disease/Treated, value, batch, sex). I also uploaded the provided test file data.csv (72 rows: sample_id, group, value, batch, sex) through 'Upload file'.

tree.general: Turn a table of experimental results into publication-ready figures with matching statistics and files that let them be rebuilt, including combining several plots into one multi-panel figure with panel labels
tree.specific: Use Make My Figure to load data, choose a plot type, map columns, style, run statistics and export SVG/PNG/PDF plus PlotSpec/StatsSpec JSON. Multi-panel assembly (Figure Builder) is a stated aim of the tool, but this browser build exposes no way to reach it (see not_done)

features.name: Publication style panel

features.specific: 5. Publication style: ① Figure (width preset, DPI, margins), ② Typography (palette, title/axis/tick/annotation pt, marker size, line width, grid), ③ Axes & labels (title, X/Y label, tick angle, Y scale/limits, paddings), ④ Legend (location, pt, outside), ⑤ Colorbar; plus Publication check banner

Read the Publication check for warnings (e.g. text too small)

features.name: Assumption-checked group comparison with on-figure annotations

features.specific: 6. Statistics: Enable statistics, Test (Auto-suggest/Student/Welch/Mann-Whitney/paired/Wilcoxon/one-way ANOVA/two-way/Kruskal-Wallis…), If assumptions fail, Correction, Annotation stars/bracket, Post-hoc pairwise; Statistics table with effect sizes and a Method paragraph
